subject: ONE male spotted hyena, grey work shirt-apron, toothy grin
second_characters: ONE goat boss in a grey vest, grid printouts under his arm from the first beat
props: ONE paper crown cut from a grid printout; ONE empty white ceramic bowl; printouts show grid lines only, no digits, no text
environment: busy office break room by day: metal lockers, bright window, kettle on a shelf, boxes; meerkat coworkers scurry past with folder stacks, two pop up over locker doors
motion_rule: the hyena moves his WHOLE body every beat; meerkats bustle behind him. He fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where a muzzle or a flying bowl fills the whole frame. The camera circles the hyena, changing angle and shot size every beat.

audio.delivery: brisk smug male hyena voice, deadpan
audio.pacing: first word at 0.4; no words 1.65-1.95, 3.0-3.4, 4.85-5.5; last word by 6.6; no words after 6.6
audio.lip_sync: the hyena speaks, jaw working on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA pa-VY-si-li. STAR-shiy YEST PER-vym. TUT PER-vym ga-la-DA-yet. za-TO f ka-RO-ne
audio.sfx: office chatter, bowl clang, paper crunch, belly growl

timeline.a: the hyena springs up from a crouch and snatches the paper crown from the goat's outstretched hoof
the hyena jams the crown on his head mid-hop, jaw working on every syllable
the hyena hunches and jerks his head left-right, sniffing like a scavenger
the hyena yanks an empty bowl from a locker and spins back clanging it with his claws, jaw working on every syllable; near foreground: a folder stack whips past the lens
close-up: the goat lunges into the lens, his muzzle filling the frame, crunching printout; the hyena blurred behind
the hyena hops side to side on his toes, shaking the upside-down bowl overhead; one crumb drops past his snout, jaw working on every syllable
close-up: the hyena hurls the empty bowl into the lens, the spinning bowl filling the frame; his belly growls
